note: Task N2: beginners search for a problem ('night', 'hungry'), not an item name. Each topic maps such words to a short answer and the items that solve it. Avoid keywords that are also item names, because an exact item name opens that item directly.

topics.title: Night is coming?
topics.advice: Standing in total darkness kills you. Build a light before the screen goes black and stay beside it until morning.

topics.title: Need wood?
topics.advice: Chop trees with an Axe to get Logs. You need Logs for fires and most buildings.

topics.title: Need rocks or flint?
topics.advice: Mine boulders with a Pickaxe. Boulders with yellow veins also drop gold.

topics.title: Getting hungry?
topics.advice: Pick berries and carrots as you explore. Set Traps on rabbit holes for meat, and cook food over a fire.

topics.title: Getting cold?
topics.advice: Winter starts around day 21. Stand by a fire to warm up, and carry a heated Thermal Stone when you travel.

topics.title: Under attack?
topics.advice: Keep a weapon and armour in your inventory. If you have neither, run: most creatures give up the chase.

topics.title: Low on health?
topics.advice: Health does not come back on its own. Use a healing item, or eat cooked food for a small boost.

topics.title: Inventory full?
topics.advice: A Backpack adds slots you carry with you. A Chest stores what you do not need right now at your camp.

topics.title: Want more recipes?
topics.advice: Stand next to a Science Machine to unlock new things to craft.
